additional_info.subject: Incident Report – Dimona Site, 11/09/2025 1700004502
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support,
On
11/09/2025 at 11:25 (IL time)
an incident occurred at the
Dimona site
, station
(S/N: 1700004502)
.
A customer reported
smoke from the vehicle inlet immediately after stopping the charging session
.
The charging cable got stuck in the vehicle, and we had to dismantle the cable from the charger until it was later removed at the workshop by the customer.
Please note that this is already the
third occurrence
of this type with these charging units.
I am attaching photos for your reference.
We kindly ask for your investigation and the provision of relevant diagnostic logs.
Best regards,
Ziv Vinizher
​
​
​
​
Ziv Vinitzer
Head of DC Charging
*5619
